profiles.read.description: Observed contract: read one exact X profile through the current captured first-party UserByScreenName GraphQL query with target-bound exact follower and following counts.

handle.description: Exact X handle without a leading @

feeds.read.description: Observed contract: read one complete bounded X For You, Following, user, List, search, or bookmarks provider page through its current captured first-party GraphQL query; bookmarks pages emit stable export items keyed by post_id plus a next-page cursor; user/List responses must echo the requested identity and an over-limit page fails without exposing its end cursor.

feed.description: Exact X timeline or discovery surface

user_id.description: Exact X user ID for a user feed

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page

posts.read.description: Observed contract: read one X post through the current captured TweetDetail first-party GraphQL query with a bounded normalized projection.

comments.read.description: Observed contract: read one complete bounded X conversation page through the current captured TweetDetail query; an over-limit reply page fails without exposing its end cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque conversation cursor returned by the preceding page

messaging.list.description: Capture-required contract reservation: current X DMs use encrypted X Chat events, so plaintext inbox listing remains disabled until verified key recovery is installed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page

messaging.read.description: Capture-required contract reservation: current X Chat events are encrypted, so plaintext conversation reads remain disabled until verified key recovery and acknowledgement-free handling are installed.

conversation_id.description: Exact opaque conversation identifier returned by messaging.list

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page

articles.read.description: Capture-required contract reservation: read one native X article only after its entitlement-specific first-party detail query and bounded projection are captured and reviewed.

messaging.send.description: Capture-required contract reservation: send one confirmed X DM, optionally with one reviewed attachment, after the current mutation, target binding, and media path are captured and reviewed.
messaging.send.sideEffect: Sends one externally visible X direct message to the exact confirmed user or conversation.

target_kind.description: Send to an existing conversation or one exact X user

target_id.description: Exact conversation or X user ID selected by target_kind

body.description: Exact direct-message text; an optional reviewed attachment may accompany it

media.description: Optional reviewed direct-message image, GIF, or video

media_alt_text.description: Optional accessibility text for reviewed image media

posts.publish.description: Observed contract: publish one confirmed X post with optional reviewed PNG or MP4 through pixels-only upload scrub, CreateTweet response, and fail-closed TweetResultByRestId Made with AI readback.
posts.publish.sideEffect: Publishes one externally visible X post with the exact confirmed content and reply audience.

media.description: Optional single plan-bound PNG or MP4

media_type.description: Exact media type when one PNG or MP4 is attached

threads.publish.description: Capture-required contract reservation: publish one confirmed text-only X thread only after an authorized live fixture proves each current CreateTweet dispatch.
threads.publish.sideEffect: Publishes one externally visible ordered X thread containing every exact confirmed item.

items.description: Exact ordered post texts, beginning with the thread root

replies.create.description: Capture-required contract reservation: publish one confirmed text-only reply only after an authorized live fixture proves current transaction-header and parent binding behavior.
replies.create.sideEffect: Publishes one externally visible X reply to the exact confirmed parent post.

posts.repost.description: Capture-required contract reservation: set repost state only after an authorized live fixture proves current transaction-header and readback behavior.
posts.repost.sideEffect: Creates or removes the authenticated account's repost of the exact confirmed X post.

posts.quote.description: Capture-required contract reservation: publish one confirmed text-only quote only after an authorized live fixture proves current transaction-header and quote binding behavior.
posts.quote.sideEffect: Publishes one externally visible X quote post for the exact confirmed source post.

likes.set.description: Observed contract: set or clear one exact X like through the current FavoriteTweet or UnfavoriteTweet mutation, then verify the desired state through an independent TweetResultByRestId readback.
likes.set.sideEffect: Sets or clears the authenticated account's like on the exact confirmed X post.

content.save.description: Observed contract: set or clear one exact X bookmark through the current first-party mutation, then verify the desired state through an independent post readback.
content.save.sideEffect: Saves or removes the exact confirmed X post in the authenticated account's bookmarks.

content.delete.description: Capture-required contract reservation: delete one exact current-account X post only after the current DeleteTweet request, accepted response, author binding, and exact not-found readback are live-proven.
content.delete.sideEffect: Permanently deletes the exact confirmed authored X post from the authenticated account.

expected_text.description: Exact current post text used for pre-delete confirmation

articles.draft.save.description: Create or replace one private native X Article draft from ArticleDraftDocument schemaVersion 2 with ordered local inline images. This operation has no publish-capable branch.
articles.draft.save.sideEffect: Creates one private native X Article draft, or replaces the exact confirmed existing private draft, with the confirmed title, structure, styles, native links, inline image bytes, and captions; it never publishes the draft.

document.description: Canonical JSON for ArticleDraftDocument schemaVersion 2; supports bounded paragraphs, headings, lists, blockquotes, native HTTPS links, text styles, and ordered inline image blocks with optional captions; X Article image alt text remains capture-required

draft_id.description: Optional exact existing private X Article draft to replace in place

inline_images.description: Ordered plan-bound local image files referenced by document imageIndex

items.description: One exact JPEG, PNG, or WebP inline image

articles.publish.description: Capture-required reservation: publish one exact existing private X Article draft only after the distinct publish mutation and public readback are captured and response-bound.
articles.publish.sideEffect: Publishes one externally visible native X Article from the exact confirmed private draft.

title.description: Exact native article title used for confirmation

body.description: Exact native article body used for confirmation

draft_id.description: Exact private X Article draft to publish
